description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Calls a Move #[view] function read-only, after checking every type argument and argument against the module's ABI: u64/u128/u256 must be decimal strings, vector<u8> a 0x hex string, Option<T> written {"vec":[]} or {"vec":[value]}, addresses in AIP-40 form. A wrong argument is a specific error from us, never an opaque node error. Optionally reads at a stated ledger version.

chain.description: Aptos CAIP-2 id: aptos:1 (mainnet, default) or aptos:2 (testnet)

ledgerVersion.description: read the chain exactly as of this ledger version (default: the current one, pinned for consistency)
